description.text1: TesloShop is a clone inspired by Tesla's E-commerce page. This project was developed during the Next.js course at the DevTalles programming academy and was later modified to introduce improvements.

stack.description: This project was developed to learn the latest features of Next.js in its new versions using app router and server actions.

list.text2: TypeScript --> For logic and type checking
list.text3: Zustand --> To manage a global state
list.text8: Prisma DB --> As ORM to handle queries and schema for the database
list.text9: Docker desktop --> To generate a local environment for the use of the database
list.text10: TablePlus --> To visualize the DB data
list.text11: Swiper --> To implement the products page carousel

spotlight.text1: This challenge allowed me to deepen my knowledge about Next.js. In addition, I used Docker Desktop for the first time to generate an image where I could run the database locally and thus have a local environment to develop the app.
spotlight.text2: It was a great technical challenge as I was able to apply everything I learned about React in a complex project, and learn in the process how to use various technologies from the stack such as: Zustand and Prisma.

lessons.text1: This E-commerce allowed me to technically test myself, as I modified part of the original functionality to achieve a better user experience.
lessons.text2: It also allowed me to integrate a payment gateway into a project for the first time, and I believe it laid a solid foundation for me to continue working on increasingly complex projects using Next.js.
